grants.name: Research and Development Tax Incentive (R&DTI)
grants.amount_note: 43.5% refundable offset (aggregated turnover < A$20M); non-refundable tax rate + 8.5%/16.5% otherwise
grants.lodgement_deadline: Register within 10 months of income-year end (30 Apr for June balancers)
grants.next_round_note: Budget 2026-27 changes apply from 1 Jul 2028: min spend A$50k, refundable threshold A$50M turnover, refundability limited to first 10 years, supporting activities removed
grants.summary: Refundable tax offset on eligible core and supporting R&D. Register activities with AusIndustry, claim via ATO tax return.

grants.name: Early Stage Innovation Company (ESIC) investor tax incentives
grants.amount_note: Investor-side: 20% non-refundable carry-forward offset capped A$200k/yr (sophisticated), A$10k invest cap retail; 10-yr CGT exemption
grants.lodgement_deadline: ESIC report to ATO by 31 Jul each year
grants.summary: Company self-assesses ESIC status; investors get a 20% offset and CGT exemption, reducing dilution pressure on the raise.

grants.name: Industry Growth Program — Early-Stage Commercialisation
grants.next_round_note: Paused to new applications since Budget night 12 May 2026; A$102M uncommitted removed at MYEFO Dec 2025; government considering redesign
grants.summary: Matched grants plus advisory for commercialising in NRF priority sectors. Watch for reopening.

grants.name: Industry Growth Program — Commercialisation and Growth
grants.summary: Larger matched grants for scaling commercial products in priority sectors.

grants.name: Accelerating Commercialisation (Entrepreneurs' Programme)
grants.next_round_note: Superseded by Industry Growth Program; historical grant still counts toward ESIC 100-point test
grants.summary: Closed 9 May 2023. Listed for history and ESIC scoring only.

grants.name: Export Market Development Grants (EMDG)
grants.amount_note: Tier 1 A$20-30k/yr, Tier 2 A$20-50k/yr, Tier 3 A$20-80k/yr; 2-year agreements
grants.next_round_note: Round 4 closed (covers FY25-26 and FY26-27). No round open. Round 5 expected ~Nov 2026 to mid-2027 after statutory review
grants.summary: Reimburses up to 50% of eligible export promotion spend for SMEs. Watch for Round 5.

grants.name: CSIRO Kick-Start
grants.amount_note: Up to 2 vouchers; minimum project A$40k
grants.summary: Dollar-matched vouchers to run R&D with CSIRO researchers.

grants.name: Cooperative Research Centres Projects (CRC-P)
grants.next_round_note: Round 19 closed 12 May 2026; outcomes Oct 2026; Round 20 expected ~Mar 2027. AI Accelerator priority A$20M
grants.summary: Industry-led collaborative research grants; SME must lead.

grants.name: Digital Solutions — Australian Small Business Advisory Services
grants.amount_note: Up to 4 hours 1:1 digital advice for a small fee
grants.summary: Low-cost digital capability advice for small businesses.

grants.name: Self-Employment Assistance (NEIS successor)
grants.amount_note: Self-Employment Allowance up to 39 weeks at JobSeeker single rate + 12 months coaching
grants.summary: Free training, coaching and an allowance for individuals starting a business.

grants.name: A$20,000 Instant Asset Write-Off
grants.amount_note: Immediate deduction per asset under A$20k
grants.summary: Small-business asset deduction; general information only — confirm with a registered tax agent.

grants.name: Australian Apprenticeships Incentive System (Priority Hiring / Key Apprenticeship Program)
grants.amount_note: KAP employer incentive up to A$5k first year; Priority Hiring Incentive per factsheet
grants.summary: Employer incentives for apprentices in priority occupations.

grants.name: Boosting Female Founders Initiative
grants.next_round_note: Wrapped after Round 3; future rounds cut in 2024-25 Budget. Do not recommend as open
grants.summary: Closed. Alternatives: QLD Female Founders Co-Investment Fund, NSW MVP Ventures Stream 2, UNSW Impact X.

grants.name: Austrade Landing Pads
grants.amount_note: Non-cash market immersion (Singapore, Indonesia, Vietnam, UK, US) + virtual bootcamps
grants.next_round_note: FY2026-27 calendar published; UK bootcamp Sep 2026, US Oct 2026, Intersekt 3-4 Sep, SFF 18-20 Nov
grants.summary: Government-run market-entry programs for scaleups.

grants.name: EFA Small Business Export Loan
grants.summary: Unsecured export loans without property security.

grants.name: National Reconstruction Fund Corporation investment
grants.amount_note: No fixed min/max; equity 10-40% or debt/guarantee
grants.summary: Government investment vehicle for priority industries. Not a grant.

grants.name: IBA Start-Up Finance Package
grants.amount_note: Loan up to A$150k, up to 30% as grant for capex, term ≤7 yrs
grants.summary: Concessional start-up finance with a grant component for Indigenous-owned businesses.

grants.name: Indigenous Procurement Policy (Supply Nation registration)

grants.summary: Demand-side access to Commonwealth contracts for Indigenous businesses.

grants.summary: Grants for renewable and enabling technology demonstration and deployment.

grants.amount_note: A$200M fund; cheque sizes vary pre-seed to growth
grants.summary: Government-backed climate-tech VC. Equity, not grant.
